notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, shelf For Other Minds (creative_due.py drew it: for-other-minds 30%). Piece: everywhere (3,334 words, text only; audio 577 MB of the 400 MB cap). A parish office agent's replace-all of a retired priest's name (1,342 mentions in 418 documents) also renames his clergy record behind 2,081 sacramental entries; a date-cutoff revert fails on 23 documents plus 6 mixed ones; the fix restores Friday's versions, splits the clergy record by dates and classifies each mention as office-now or act-then (96 changed, 19 + 1,227 kept, 11 decided by people). Claimed with a BIBLE proposal and draft PR before drafting. Adversarial re-read caught: new priest 'in secondary school' in 2031 at 23 (fixed: seminarian), clergy-list history contradiction with registers back to 1864 (fixed), a muddled safeguarding line (fixed). Checks: node --test in hearth-and-horizon 17/17 pass; check_post_frontmatter ok on 5377 posts; check_post_links 0 broken; check_doc_counts 0 drifted. No separate agent doc: nothing a next run needs beyond the BIBLE timeline row and DONE entry.
